opaque Input : Type

 def A1 (input : Input) : Prop := conformsToSpecification input

theorem O1 : ∀ input : Input, A1 input → ∀ edge : EdgeId, outputContains (solve input) edge ↔ isBridge input edge := by sorry

theorem O2 : ∀ input : Input, outputIsSorted (solve input) := by sorry

theorem O4 : ∀ input : Input, outputIsJSONCompatible (solve input) := by sorry

theorem O5 : solve publicExampleOne = publicExampleOneExpected ∧ solve publicExampleTwo = publicExampleTwoExpected := by sorry

theorem O3 : ∀ input : Input, preservesGraphInvariants input (solve input) := by sorry

theorem G2 : ∀ first second : Input, first = second → solve first = solve second := by sorry

theorem G1 : usesOnlyStandardLibraryAndNoExternalIO := by sorry

theorem A1_nonvacuity : ∃ input : Input, A1 input := by sorry
